about: The tags every Doman Digital repo must carry. Read by scripts/check-repo-metadata.mjs on every PR, and by claude-kit's daily estate audit. Add a word here before using it on a repo.

rules.description: Required. 350 characters at most, no em or en dashes.
rules.client: client-site and client-app need exactly one client-<name> tag. Other kinds may carry one when the work is for a client.
rules.business: Every kind except personal and it-portfolio carries doman-digital.
